claims_upheld: A live PNet Network Engineering agency advert for the recorded title/location/reference was retrievable on 2026-10-06.
Network Engineering is an official Network Recruitment engineering division.
The role requirements and any displayed pay were transcribed from the direct listing, not inferred from company characteristics.
claims_downgraded: A live PNet page does not confirm the end employer still accepts applications.
Agency advertiser identity is not end-employer identity.
Core duties are mechanical plant maintenance, not ERP implementation/support; pay and employer unresolved.
contradictions: The official Network South Africa engineering job-search form did not render vacancy cards through the retrieved page parser; PNet remains a secondary fallback, not a complete native-feed substitute.
unknowns: End-employer name and employer-side requisition status are unresolved.
Client/agreed-client status is unresolved; no Boschendal or Laurium match is evidenced.
Duplicate lineage beyond the explicitly noted expired predecessor/common-client hypothesis is not confirmed.
Salary threshold is unresolved where the direct listing gives no numeric amount.
next_research_actions: Seek an agency-origin or employer-origin source that identifies the hiring employer and confirms the requisition is still open; do not infer from generic industry wording.
Resolve salary against the R420,000 p.a. floor before treating a salary-unknown role as economically qualified.
Do not begin end-employer stakeholder/company-email research or candidate mapping until employer resolution is CONFIRMED or HIGH_CONFIDENCE.
